name: Sethur
title: The Spy from the Tribe of Asher
summary: Sethur, son of Michael, was the representative from the tribe of Asher among the twelve spies that Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He was one of the ten spies who returned with a negative report and discouraged the Israelites from entering the land, which led to God's judgment of 40 years of wandering in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as a Spy
keyEvents.description: Setur, son of Michael, was chosen by Moses as the representative of the tribe of Asher to spy out the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Mission to Canaan
keyEvents.description: Moses sent Setur along with eleven other spies from the wilderness of Paran to explore the land of Canaan and report on its people, cities, and resources.

keyEvents.title: Exploring the Land
keyEvents.description: The spies, including Setur, explored the land for forty days, from the wilderness of Zin all the way to Rehob near Lebo-Hamat.

keyEvents.title: The Negative Report
keyEvents.description: Setur was among the ten spies who gave a negative report, claiming that the people in the land were too strong and that the Israelites could not take it.

keyEvents.title: The People's Rebellion
keyEvents.description: The negative report from Setur and the other spies caused the entire congregation of Israel to weep and grumble against Moses and Aaron, wishing to return to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment and the Death of the Spies
keyEvents.description: As punishment for the false report and for causing the people to grumble, Zethur and the other ten spies died of a plague in the Lord's presence. Only Joshua and Caleb survived.
